mapper.insert: INSERT INTO provider_events(event_id,event_type,provider,payload,processed_date) VALUES(#{event.eventId},#{event.eventType},'YCLOUD',#{event.payload}, CASE WHEN #{event.eventType}='whatsapp.message.updated' THEN NULL ELSE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP END)
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_events SET processed_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE event_id=#{eventId}
mapper.select: SELECT event_id,payload,forward_attempts AS attempts FROM provider_events WHERE forwarded_date IS NULL AND next_forward_date<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY next_forward_date,event_id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE provider_events SET forwarded_date=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,forward_attempts=forward_attempts+1 WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND forwarded_date IS NULL
UPDATE provider_events SET next_forward_date=#{nextTime},forward_attempts=forward_attempts+1 WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND forwarded_date IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT event_id FROM provider_events WHERE processed_date IS NULL AND next_process_date<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY next_process_date,event_id LIMIT 100

mapper.update: UPDATE provider_events SET next_process_date=#{nextTime},process_attempts=process_attempts+1 WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND processed_date IS NULL
